title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 7: two kings against Jerusalem, the sign Ahaz would not ask, and the child named Immanuel.

questions.text: Which two kings went up to Jerusalem to war against it in the days of Ahaz?
questions.explanation: Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail.

answers.text: The kings of Assyria and Egypt
The kings of Babylon and Moab
Rezin king of Syria and Pekah king of Israel
The kings of Edom and Ammon

questions.text: How did the heart of Ahaz and his people tremble at the news that Syria was allied with Ephraim?
questions.explanation: His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

answers.text: As the trees of the forest tremble with the wind
As the waves of the sea in a storm
As a dry leaf before the burning fire
As the mountains shake in an earthquake

questions.text: Whom was Isaiah told to take with him when he went out to meet Ahaz?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Isaiah to go out to meet Ahaz with Shearjashub his son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool.

questions.text: What are the two angry kings called in the message to Ahaz?
questions.explanation: Ahaz is told not to be afraid because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria and of the son of Remaliah.

questions.text: Whom did Syria and Ephraim plan to set up as king within Judah?
questions.explanation: They said, "Let's go up against Judah, and tear it apart... and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel."

questions.text: Within how many years would Ephraim be broken in pieces, so that it would not be a people?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people."

questions.text: What did Ahaz say when he was told to ask a sign of Yahweh his God?
questions.explanation: Ahaz said, "I won't ask. I won't tempt Yahweh."

answers.text: "Give me a sign in the heavens"
"I won't ask. I won't tempt Yahweh."
"Let the shadow go back ten steps"

questions.text: What name will the virgin's son be called, according to the sign the Lord gives?
questions.explanation: The sign is, "Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel."

questions.text: What shall the child eat when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good?
questions.explanation: The text says, "He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good."

questions.text: With whom will the Lord shave like a hired razor in that day?
questions.explanation: The text says the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria.
